question.text: A parallel plate capacitor $C$ with plates of unit area and separation $d$ is filled with a liquid of dielectric constant $K=2$. The level of liquid is $\frac{d}{3}$ initially. Suppose the liquid level decreases at a constant speed $v$, the time constant as a function of time $t$ is

options.text: $\frac{(15 d+9 v t) \varepsilon_0 R}{2 d^2-3 d v t-9 v^2 t^2}$
$\frac{(15 d-9 v t) \varepsilon_0 R}{2 d^2+3 d v t-9 v^2 t^2}$
